description: This line plot illustrates the perplexity of three different large language models—LLaMA-7B, LLaMA-13B, and Vicuna-7B—as a function of the parameter M, which ranges from 3 to 8 on the linear x-axis labeled "M". The y-axis, labeled "Perplexity", is also linear and spans from 20.0 to 40.0. The plot displays three distinct lines: the LLaMA-7B model is represented by a green line with circular markers that starts at a perplexity of approximately 29.0 at M=3 and ends at approximately 36.0 at M=8, showing a steady increase; the LLaMA-13B model is shown as an orange line with star-shaped markers, beginning at a perplexity of approximately 20.0 at M=3 and ending at approximately 21.0 at M=8, remaining relatively flat; and the Vicuna-7B model is depicted by a blue line with triangular markers, starting at a perplexity of approximately 40.0 at M=3, decreasing to approximately 35.0 at M=6, then increasing again to approximately 40.0 at M=8.
